index.description: A command-style index frame: an optional filter field over grouped and loose nav_link rows.

attributes.name: search
attributes.description: Shows the filter field, using this text as its placeholder. Written bare (no value), the field appears with the default placeholder "Search". Left out entirely, no field is shown.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: A key-cap chip shown at the end of the search field. A label only; this pack binds no keyboard shortcut.

group.description: A card grouping nav_link rows under a heading with a tone-tinted icon tile.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The heading shown at the top of the card.

attributes.name: desc
attributes.description: A muted line under the title.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: The glyph shown in the heading's icon tile.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: The color tint applied to the icon tile.

link.description: One row: an icon, a label, an optional description, an optional key-cap hint, and an optional link.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The row's label, used when the directive has no bracket content.

attributes.name: desc
attributes.description: A muted description shown under the label.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: The row's destination. Only http(s), mailto, and relative/fragment addresses are accepted; anything else is left out and the row renders without a link.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: A key-cap hint shown at the end of the row. A label only; this pack binds no keyboard shortcut.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: The glyph shown at the start of the row.
